  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, February 10, 2026  7:00 PM  Council Chamber

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstates.gov and
  during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's web
  site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on PVP -TV
  Channel 35 (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

3.  ROLL CALL

4.  CEREMONIAL ITEMS

  NONE

5.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of the
  City Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown by a member
  prior to the roll call vote. (Items removed for individual consideration will be voted on separately.)

  A.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
  Reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions presented for consideration to
  the City Council will be waived and all such ordinances and resolutions will be
  read by title only.

  B.  DEMANDS AND WARRANTS OF JANUARY 2026
  Recommendation: Approve warrants 69286 through 69343 in the amount of
  $1,000,049.27; and Supplemental Warrants 011326 through 011426; in the
  amount of $141,320.99 for a grand total amount of $1,141,370.26 with proper
  audit.
  Attachments: Demands & Warrants

  C.  BUDGET AMENDMENTS FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026
  Recommendation: That the City Council approve the Budget Amendments for
  Fiscal Year 2025-2026.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  D.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF JANUARY 27, 2026
  Recommendation: Review and approve.
  Attachments: Draft Minutes

  E.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF JANUARY 20, 2026
  Recommendation: Receive and file.
  Attachments: Draft Minutes

  F.  SOUTH BAY CITIES COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS' BOARD MEETING
  HIGHLIGHTS
  Recommendation: Receive and file.
  Attachments: Staff Report

6.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS
  This is the appropriate time for members of the public to make comments regarding items not listed on this
  agenda. If you would like to address the City Council, please complete a speaker sheet and give to the City
  Clerk. Under the State's open meeting law - the Brown Act - no action may be taken on any item not on the
  agenda.

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  NONE

8.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  RESOLUTION NO. 2617 TO AMEND AUTHORIZED POSITION PLAN

  Memorandum from Alexa Davis, Assistant City Manager
  Recommendation: That the City Council adopt a Resolution 2617 amending the
  City’s authorized position plan to remove one Administrative Analyst position
  from the Professional Employee Group and add one Administrative Assistant
  position to the Classified Employee Group to align staffing with current
  operational needs within the Community Development and Public Works
  Departments.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  B.  MASTER PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT AND TASK ORDER
  WITH  TRANSTECH  ENGINEERS  INC.  FOR CONSTRUCTION
  INSPECTION AND SOILS AND MATERIALS TESTING SERVICES FOR
  THE GEORGE F CANYON NATURE CENTER PROJECT
  Memorandum from Kirsten Graham, Public Works Manager
  Recommendation: That the City Council approve: 1) a Master Professional
  Services Agreement (MPSA) with Transtech Engineers, Inc. for on-call project
  management, construction management, construction inspection, and
  specialized testing services; and 2) Task Order 2026-01, under the MPSA, in
  the not-to-exceed amount of $361,070.00 for construction inspection and soils
  and materials testing services for the George F Canyon Nature Center Project,
  subject to approval as to form by the City Attorney.
  Attachments: Staff Report

9.  OLD BUSINESS

  A.  CONSIDERATION OF PETITION TO RECONSIDER RIGHT TURN ON
  RED RESTRICTION AT PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH AND PALOS
  VERDES DRIVE EAST
  Memorandum from Greg Grammer, City Manager and Kirsten Graham, Public
  Works Manager
  Recommendation: that the City Council consider the petition and determine
  whether to reconsider the previously approved “No Right Turn on Red”
  restriction at a future City Council meeting.
  Attachments: Staff Report

10.  CITY ATTORNEY ITEMS

11.  CITY COUNCIL / REGIONAL COMMITTEE REPORTS
  This item provides the opportunity for Members of the City Council to provide information and reports to
  other Members of the City Council and the public on any issues or activities of Council Committees, ad hoc
  committees, regional or state-wide governmental associations, special districts, joint powers authorities
  and the various committees on which Members of the City Council might serve or have an interest, which
  are not otherwise agendized.

12.  MAYOR AND COUNCIL ITEMS
  This item provides the opportunity for Members of the City Council to request information on currently
  pending projects and/or issues of public concern, direct that an item be agendized for future consideration
  and/or make announcements of interest to the public.

  A.  CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS 2026

  Memorandum from Greg Grammer, City Manager
  Recommendation: That the City Council review and discuss the proposed
  Council/Committee assignments and approve as presented.
  Attachments: Staff Report

  B.  2026 COMMITTEE APPOINTMENTS

  Memorandum from Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
  Recommendation: That the City Council make appointments for the
  Environmental Advisory Committee and Traffic & Safety Committee from the
  list of interviewed candidates.
  Attachments: Staff Report

13.  CLOSED SESSION
  If you would like to address the City Council regarding an item on the Closed Session agenda, please
  contact the City Manager or City Clerk. Any reportable action taken in Closed Session will be reported in
  Open Session.

  NONE

14.  ADJOURNMENT
  Next meeting: February 24, 2026
